ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The left figure is a map of a peninsula region, with latitude and longitude lines and elevation layered shading, and the three places Jia, Yi, and Bing are marked in the figure. Jia is located on the western coast of the peninsula, near about 40°N, on the Atlantic Ocean side, and the terrain appears to be low to medium elevation. The right figure is a graph of changes in multi-year average monthly precipitation, the horizontal axis is 1-12 months, the vertical axis is precipitation, and the three line graphs are respectively labeled ①②③: ① has relatively more precipitation in winter and autumn, clearly little rain in summer, and the overall precipitation is medium; ② has relatively little precipitation throughout the year; ③ has very high precipitation in winter, little rain in summer, and overall, especially winter, precipitation is relatively high. Then reason: Jia is on the western Atlantic coast, belongs to a Mediterranean climate influence area, and the seasonal distribution of precipitation should show rainy winter and dry summer. But Jia is not the wettest windward mountain area or the northwestern high-precipitation area, so it should not correspond to ③ with extremely high winter precipitation; ② is also too dry throughout the year, which does not conform to the precipitation conditions of Jia on the west coast. ① reflects the characteristics of winter rain and summer dryness of medium intensity, and best fits place Jia.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the left panel is a peninsula map with points 甲、乙、丙 and altitude shading; 甲 lies on the west coast/Atlantic side near 40°N, at relatively low to moderate altitude. The right panel gives three monthly precipitation curves labeled ①②③. Then reason that 甲 should have a Mediterranean-type seasonal rhythm: obvious winter rainfall and summer drought, but not the extremely high winter precipitation of the windward mountainous/northwestern site. On the graph, curve ① shows this moderate winter-wet, summer-dry pattern; curve ② is too dry overall and curve ③ is too wet. Therefore 甲 corresponds to precipitation curve ①.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：左图是一幅半岛区域地图，带有经纬线和海拔分层阴影，图中标出甲、乙、丙三地。甲位于半岛西部沿海、接近40°N附近，靠大西洋一侧，地势表现为较低到中等海拔。右图是多年平均逐月降水量变化图，横轴为1—12月，纵轴为降水量，三条折线分别标为①②③：①冬季和秋季降水较多、夏季明显少雨，整体降水量中等；②全年降水偏少；③冬季降水很高、夏季少雨，整体尤其冬季降水偏多。
再推理：甲在西部大西洋沿岸，属于地中海气候影响区，降水季节分配应表现为冬季多雨、夏季干旱。但甲不是最湿润的迎风山地或西北部高降水区，所以不应对应冬季降水极高的③；②又全年过干，不符合西岸甲地的降水条件。①体现了中等强度的冬雨夏干特征，最符合甲地。
